description: Look up an Agent ID (ERC-8004, Arc's Identity Registry) by its number or by wallet. By number: owner, verified agent wallet, agentURI and the parsed profile (name, description, image, services), read live from the chain. By wallet: the IDs whose verified wallet it is, newest first, with the newest one's full record; `index.complete` is false while ubi.fun's index of the registry is still catching up.

agentId.description: The Agent ID number; pass this or wallet, not both

wallet.description: A wallet: finds the IDs whose verified wallet it is; pass this or agentId, not both

name: get_agent_id
